description: Checkout API application database connections were under pressure in production ca-central-1.
issue_summary: At capture, the application connection pool was 97% utilized, with 34 acquisition timeouts per minute and a 2,100 ms p95 acquisition wait.
trigger_summary: The 97% application pool utilization exceeded the documented 90% threshold. That threshold must persist for 5 minutes, which this snapshot cannot independently verify; the alternative acquisition-timeout trigger has no numeric threshold recorded here.
trace_summary: checkout-api requests hold a database connection while waiting on inventory-service. No new checkout-api revision in the incident window.

events.message: Timed out acquiring an application database connection while inventory-service response was pending.
Connection acquisition wait exceeded 2 seconds; database server health check remained normal.
